The top panel shows the 12-month change in headline and core PCE prices since 2019, with a shaded range for six other measures of underlying inflation; all rose sharply in 2021 and 2022, settled between about 2 and 3.5 percent in 2024 and 2025, and turned up in 2026. The bottom panel shows each measure in July 2026 over 12 months and over six months at an annual rate: headline 3.7 and 4.1 percent, core 3.3 and 3.5, excluding energy goods 3.3 and 3.3, market-based core 3.0 and 3.2, market-based core excluding housing 3.0 and 3.1, median 2.7 and 2.9, the New York Fed trend 2.7, and the trimmed mean 2.3 and 2.4.">
